import re
import pytest
from target import url_basename

# Reference implementation using the old regex
def old_url_basename(url):
    m = re.match(r'(?:https?:|)//[^/]+/(?:[^?#]+/)?([^/?#]+)/?(?:[?#]|$)', url)
    if not m:
        return u''
    return m.group(1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url",
    [
        "http://example.com/foo/bar",
        "https://example.com/foo/",
        "//example.com/foo/bar?query=1",
        "http://example.com/foo/bar#section",
        "http://example.com/foo/bar/",
        "http://example.com/foo",
        "http://example.com/",
        "http://example.com",
        "ftp://example.com/foo",
        "http://example.com/a/b/c",
        "https://sub.domain.co.uk/path/to/resource?arg=val#frag",
        "http://127.0.0.1:8080/dir/file.txt",
        "http://[2001:db8::1]/ipv6/path",
        "http://example.com//double/slash",
        "http://example.com/mixed?query=1#frag",
    ],
)
def test_url_basename_matches_old_behavior(url):
    assert url_basename(url) == old_url_basename(url)
